privacy.intro: Decide who sees which personal data. Applies to all members of this organisation.

privacy.statisticsPerPersonPublicHint: Off: members with read access only see their own figures in the statistics. Writers, treasurers and admins always see everyone.

export.title: Club export
export.description: All club data for further use: Excel tables (members, events, attendance, fines, finances, tasks, lists), the PDFs of closed minutes and optionally photos, submissions and documents as original files. Without credentials. The export is created in the background and can be downloaded for 7 days. Requires a sign-in confirmed with two-factor authentication.
export.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. Stored encrypted only until the export is created – without the password the file cannot be opened.
export.hint: AES-256 encrypted. Open with e.g. 7-Zip (Windows), Keka (macOS) or WinRAR.
export.queued: The export is being created. You can leave this page.
export.failed: The export could not be started.

privacy.noticeUrlHint: Before uploading, the upload box shows that your club is responsible and links to this page. Empty = the platform’s default notice.

activity.intro: Changes, sign-ins and accesses by the hocX platform to this organisation's data. Without IP or email addresses.

retention.intro: Decide how long the club keeps certain data. All rules are off until you switch them on. hocX suggests matching entries every day; you confirm or dismiss them. Former members are only deactivated, never deleted.

submissions_months.label: Delete upload box submissions after the deadline
submissions_months.hint: Applies to submissions with a deadline. The submitted files and their previews are deleted.

former_members_years.label: Deactivate former members after they leave
former_members_years.hint: Login is blocked and running sessions end. Name, attendance, fines and minutes stay unchanged.

unlinked_gallery_years.label: Suggest old gallery images without album or event

retention.autoApply: Apply suggestions for submissions and former members automatically
retention.autoApplyHint: Gallery images always remain a suggestion. Every action is listed in the activity log.
retention.applyConfirm: {count, plural, one {Apply one suggestion?} other {Apply # suggestions?}} Submissions and gallery images are deleted permanently, members are deactivated.

eventFields.description: Give the special fields your own names or hide them. This applies everywhere events are shown and edited.
eventFields.help: Empty = default name. Hidden fields keep their values and can be shown again at any time.
eventFields.saveFailed: Special fields could not be saved

replacesDomainHint: Replaces {domain} once verification succeeds. Until then, {domain} stays active unchanged.
domainsLoadFailed: The domains could not be loaded. Domains that are already set up are not affected.
domainsDescriptionWithDomain: Custom domains for the hocX app, the submission box and the verification page. {appDomain} and the standard submission box address always remain reachable as well.
dnsIntroShort: Add these two records for {domain} at your domain provider (where the domain is registered), then click «Verify now».
replaceNotice: {domain} is active for this purpose. The new domain only replaces it once its verification succeeds – until then {domain} keeps working unchanged.
dnsWaitHint: New DNS records often take a few minutes, sometimes up to a few hours. Only check once both records are set: 20 checks per hour are possible. Use «Finish later» to come back at any time.

help.domains: A custom domain (e.g. app.club.ch) makes hocX, the submission box or the verification page available under your own address. There is one active domain per purpose; a new one only replaces it after successful verification.
help.dns: The TXT record proves that you own the domain. The CNAME record points the address to hocX. A root domain without a prefix (club.ch) cannot have a CNAME with many providers – use a subdomain such as app.club.ch or an A record pointing to the same IP address as the target.
help.publicSlug: Short, unique name of your club made of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Other organizations find you by it, e.g. when sharing a photo album. Submission box links do not depend on it and remain valid if you change it.
help.modules: «Active» means fully usable. «Read only» means the module is no longer part of your subscription, but your data is kept and readable; changes are blocked until the module is booked again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait about an hour and try again.
errors.domain_invalid_format: This is not a valid domain. Example: app.club.ch (without https:// and without a path).
errors.domain_reserved: This domain belongs to hocX itself and cannot be added.
errors.domain_domain_taken: This domain is already active for another organization.
errors.domain_already_active: This domain is already active for this purpose.
errors.domain_txt_missing: The TXT record {record} with the verification value was not found yet. Check name and value at your domain provider or wait until the change has propagated.
errors.domain_not_routed: {domain} does not point to {target} yet. Check the CNAME or A record or wait until the change has propagated.

renameRevokesVerificationConfirm: Your club is verified by hocX. Changing the name revokes this verification, and new PDFs will no longer be shown as verified. You can request it again under Organization settings → Authenticity check. Save anyway?
moduleReadOnlyHint: No longer in your subscription: data stays readable, changes are blocked.
changePlanHint: To change your plan or book modules, contact the operator of your hocX instance.
